definition.def: A presumption is something that is accepted as true but is not certain to be true.
examples: ...the presumption that a defendant is innocent until proved guilty.
I'm having to make a lot of presumptions since I don't really know anything about the case.

definition.def: If you describe someone's behaviour as presumption, you disapprove of it because they are doing something that they have no right to do. [formal, disapproval]
examples: They were angered by his presumption.
